newsitem.title: UK: Five dead in British helicopter crash, police say.
newsitem.headline: Five dead in British helicopter crash, police say.

text.p: Five people died when a civilian helicopter crashed on Tuesday in Cheshire, northern England, police said.
"So far, using thermal imaging equipment, we have identified the location of five bodies," a police spokeswoman said.
A spokesman for Cheshire fire services said the helicopter had crashed in a wooded area near a farm.
Up to 40 firefighters were at the scene where the French-built twin-engined Squirrel Spatiale crashed. More than a dozen people had called emergency services reporting an explosion in the area.
